title: Share of 2021 US drug overdose deaths that involved an opioid

source.name: Drug Overdose Deaths in the U.S. Top 100,000 Annually
source.publisher: CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)

notes: Of the roughly 107,000 total US drug overdose deaths in 2021, CDC/NCHS reported that more than 80,000 (about 75%) involved an opioid.
